rationale: The v1 Entity proto field 'name' (field 2) has been renamed to 'display_name'. Protobuf JS/TS codegen converts snake_case field names to camelCase accessors (displayName). The TypeScript runtime must use the new accessor 'displayName' for both reading (line 13) and constructing (line 83) v1 entities. The observation key changes from 'name' to 'display_name' as specified. v2 Entity is unaffected. No test sources are modified.

Wire format compatibility is maintained (same field number 2)
